name: badge
behavior: Non-interactive status label; no APG pattern (presentational text — count-only badges require an accessible text alternative on the host)

parts.note: tone axis selects the status family: status-<tone>-surface / on-status-<tone> / status-<tone>-border (info shown as representative)

anatomyNotes: count-badge (numeric, often anchored to an avatar/icon) and label-badge (text pill) are the SAME anatomy — count uses type-data numerals and may collapse to a dot at small sizes; both are recipe differences on root. Status components take the tone axis, never emphasis; solid uses on-status-* on status-* fill, outline uses status-<tone> content on status-<tone>-surface with status-<tone>-border.
